description: Safe debloat rules for Motorola smartphones running My UX and Hello UI.

rules.name: Motorola Notifications
rules.description: Sends customer satisfaction surveys, feedback questionnaires, and promotional product marketing notifications.

rules.name: Hello You (Moto Discover)
rules.description: Preloaded discovery hub displaying trending commercial news feeds, sponsored games, and promotional articles.

rules.name: Moto Device Help
rules.description: Device troubleshooting guides and hardware diagnostic tests. Safe to remove if not needing hardware diagnostics.

rules.name: Moto Care Telemetry
rules.description: Diagnostic telemetry service collecting battery statistics, app crashes, and hardware usage data.

rules.name: Moto Care Internal Diagnostics
rules.description: Internal diagnostic monitor tracking system performance and transmitting crash dumps to Lenovo/Motorola servers.

rules.name: Moto Gametime
rules.description: Gaming overlay providing game-specific shortcuts, screen capture, and notification blocking.

rules.name: Apps Brasil (Partner App Installer)
rules.description: Regional partner app installer that silently downloads sponsored apps during initial setup on Latin America carrier models.

rules.name: Motorola Carrier Setup
rules.description: Carrier customization stub pushing carrier-specific bloatware and initial boot configurations.

rules.name: Motorola Mobile Kit
rules.description: Support framework for Motorola diagnostic and partner tools.

rules.name: Moto Signature
rules.description: Motorola device branding watermark and promotional sticker generator.

rules.name: Motorola Audio Monitor
rules.description: Audio environment analysis daemon used for automated profile switching.

rules.name: Moto Display (Peek Display)
rules.description: Interactive ambient lockscreen showing notifications on motion detection. Safe to disable if using standard AOD or standard lockscreen.

rules.name: Moto Actions (Gestures)
rules.description: Hardware sensor gesture service (chop twice for flashlight, twist for quick capture camera). Keep if using Moto gestures.

rules.name: Moto Family Space
rules.description: Sandboxed space for kids or guest users restricting access to selected apps.

rules.name: Motorola FM Radio
rules.description: Built-in analog FM radio player. Safe to remove if using streaming music apps or if headphone jack is unused.
